stars.floor_gap_conservative: Minimum y17 above terrain absolute bound14; allow <=.65m projected halo for supported capture viewports, leaving >=2.35m. Postprocessing is image-space softness, not additional collision geometry.

as_built.beam_source: Current fixed emitter/front cohorts and separate pulse envelope, replacing the four-second modulo gate
as_built.music: Exact existing bytes/clock/headroom unchanged; candidate timings not listening approved
